competency_fulfillment.rationale: Every sample asks the student to sum coin values, e.g. "What is the total value of 1 ₱5 coin and 1 ₱1 coin?" ('What is the total value of...'); none asks to recognize, name, or identify the notation of a single coin or bill, the verb and noun this competency actually names.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: No sample presents a coin or bill for naming or notation-writing (e.g. identifying a ₱20 bill by appearance or reading its printed value); the recognition sub-case this competency is entirely about never occurs.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sentence structure is simple and readable, e.g. "What is the total value of 1 ₱5 coin and 2 ₱1 coins?", appropriate for Grade 1 Q4 even though the task itself is off-target.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formatter shells vary (mcq, read_mcq, set_fill_in_blank, cloze) but the underlying task never varies away from summing coin values toward an actual recognition-style item.

competency_alignment.rationale: This node's eight samples are word-for-word identical to node mat_g1_na_q4_4's samples (e.g. "What is the total value of 1 ₱10 coin and 2 ₱5 coins?" appears verbatim in both), so the observed variation builds q4_4's 'determine value' competency, not this node's 'recognize coins and notations' competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Totals produced (6, 7, 13, 16, 20) stay within the competency's ₱100 ceiling, though this is incidental since the samples test valuation rather than recognition.
